name: clipshed
description: Local-first video range clipper: fetch only the section you need as MP4, MP3, or both.
author: Clipshed

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.desktop:check: node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check scripts/build-desktop.mjs && node --check scripts/check-desktop.mjs && node --check scripts/check-version.mjs && node --check scripts/release.mjs
scripts.desktop:run: npm run desktop:verify && npm run build && npm run desktop:server && electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:verify && npm run build && npm run desktop:server && electron-builder --dir
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:verify && npm run build && npm run desktop:server && electron-builder --win nsis portable
